description: Initializer: init.sh, memory files, LICENSE, .env.example, secret scan config
Synthetic org: 4 departments, 40 people, about 300 documents with access rules and three traps (twin, single person, folder)
Eval suite of 150 to 200 questions, each with an asker and the documents that may appear
Chunks with access metadata in SQLite, BM25, SQL grants match the reference rules
Hash embedder for tests, FastEmbed MiniLM for dense and hybrid search
Scripted fake model that quotes its context with citations
Four enforcement modes: pre-filter, post-filter, redact after, none
Metrics: accuracy, leak rate, over-blocking, latency p50 and p95 with 95% intervals
Leak gate: modes 1 and 2 have zero leaks on the full suite (fails the build), modes 3 and 4 show leaks
Audit log of every query: identity, returned document IDs, denied chunks, and no document text
MCP server over stdio with search, get_doc and who_knows, smoke test with the official client
Tests run offline with a network guard
Final numbers from held-out seed 2, run once after every other feature passed
README table with accuracy, leak rate, over-blocking, latency p50 and p95 per mode, and the rule of three note, written by a script
Quality bar: README sections, CI with badge, CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, issue templates, topics, social preview, static results page, DEMO.md, link check
Release check: review, security audit, gitleaks, pip-audit, ruff S, actionlint, links, outside check
Release candidate and hand-off: CHANGELOG SHA, HUMAN_STEPS.md, GITHUB_ABOUT.md, topics.txt
